items.title: Enhance agentic workflows with enterprise search using Kore.ai and Amazon Q Business
items.raw_excerpt: In this post, we demonstrate how organizations can enhance their employee productivity by integrating Kore.ai’s AI for Work platform with Amazon Q Business. We show how to configure AI for Work as a data accessor for Amazon Q index for independent software vendors (ISVs), so employees can search enterprise knowledge and execute end-to-end agentic workflows involving search, reasoning, actions, and content generation.

items.title: Microsoft says AI can create “zero day” threats in biology
